name: Acinque S.p.A.
summary: Acinque S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a multi-utility company in Italy. The company manages the sale of gas and related electricity; provides value-added and heat management services; electricity generation from hydroelectric and photovoltaic systems; installation of electrical columns and radio frequency networks; and microgeneration activities. It also manages gas, electricity, and water distribution network services; and operates in the urban district heating sector. In addition, the company is involved in urban hygiene and waste-to-energy activities; retail distribution of fuels, such as traditional fuels, methane, and LNG; and operation of pharmacies.
